Module Canon and Source Priority

Primary design instructions: compendium layout for chatgpt.odt.

Geographic authority: the in-game GM world map controls the spelling and relative placement of mapped locations. Dynamic tokens, hostile-village markers, and colored boundaries describe campaign state and may change.

Canonical forms

  • Wolfsgarde; Arnmar Carhice; Skyefyre; Harald; Silvercove; Morlalin; Naenadell; Brookside; Heellond; Order of Aurem; Arniean.
  • Orbryn Silverhammer is female.
  • Session 16 arrival in Pallon is normalized to 22 April 843 AC.
  • Ocean’s Eight and Ocean’s Three are successive party names reflecting changes in party size.

Distinctions

  • SSE: Shining Star Empire, the pre-Cataclysm polity.
  • SSP: Shining Star Protectorate, the post-Cataclysm successor.
  • War Golems: purpose-built Shining Star military constructs.
  • Warforged: a broader ancestry or independently sentient constructed person, such as AIDAN.
  • Sister Amara and Lady Amara Grethry are distinct people; whether they are related is unresolved.
  • Brother Salla and Sister Salla are distinct religious figures. Brother and Sister are monastic or clerical honorifics; a family relationship is possible but unestablished.

Faction inspirations

  • The Shining Star Empire and Protectorate are institutionally and aesthetically patterned after the Catholic Church.
  • Kergrin draws on Nordic society as understood by the campaign author and general dwarvish lore.
  • Yemthas is loosely inspired by North Korea: insularity, controlled movement, rigid hierarchy, restricted information, and suspicion of outsiders.
  • Castlemarch draws on Constantinople and the Byzantine Empire.
  • The Order of Aurem is inspired by the Templars.

These are broad design inspirations rather than one-to-one historical copies.
